title: About
text:
I’m Ankit Kothawade, a data scientist in Glasgow. I decode UK public data and test forecasts honestly, including the ones where I lose.
MSc Advanced Computer Science with Data Science (Distinction), University of Strathclyde. Before that I built production ETL pipelines at Cognizant and co-founded an AdTech startup.
